neighbours.label: Explaining how software interprets structured input or defines syntax and data representations.
fire: The parser treats a comma as a separator between adjacent fields in each record.
In this expression, the question mark makes the preceding group optional.
The manual explains how to define named parameters for the function call.
A column specification gives the type and width of every field in the table.
The pattern matcher interprets square brackets as a set of permitted characters.
This configuration format represents a mapping as pairs of keys and values.
The command accepts a range written as two integer endpoints separated by a dash.
To define an entity, provide a canonical name and the alternative strings it recognizes.
quiet: The parser was installed on the workstation after the administrator downloaded its latest release.
Our expression editor has a pale background and a small toolbar along the top.
A reviewer found the function manual readable and praised the quality of its printing.
The table editor opened quickly and used less memory than the previous version.
The pattern matching package was maintained by volunteers working in several countries.
This configuration editor was purchased with the remaining software budget last spring.
The command utility ran on both laptops without requiring an additional installation step.
The entity management tool received a new icon and a redesigned welcome screen.

notes: The card is broad, with technical explanations mixed with isolated initial-letter pieces. Exploration did not separate regular expressions from other code descriptions, so the hypothesis is about explaining software representations rather than a regex keyword. Controls discuss the same software categories without explaining their syntax.
